user.title: Connect to Meteo.gr
user.description:
Enter the City ID for the location you want to monitor.

### How to find your City ID:
1. Go to [meteo.gr](https://meteo.gr) and search for your location/city.
2. Check your browser's address bar (URL).
3. Copy the numeric ID following `city_id=` (for example, in `https://meteo.gr/cf.cfm?city_id=12`, the City ID is **12**).

data_description.city_id: The numeric ID from the meteo.gr URL (e.g., 12 for Athens, 28 for Thessaloniki).
